messages.author: 48ade59a0ba8202f
messages.subject: defining root of a dendrogram
parts:
Hi,
I am using aboot to draw a UPGMA dendrogram for a dominant marker dataset that contains a known outgroup. My question is that how is the root selected, or is there a way to define an outgroup and/or the root for the dataset.

Many thanks for help.
IH

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] defining root of a dendrogram
parts:
Hi I.H.,

Currently, there is no way to specify a specific root. The function aboot was designed to take a data set, generate a tree from the observed data, and pass that and the distance function to boot.phylo. UPGMA trees are rooted by the nature of their construction and thus the root is dependent on the data.

Zhian
